# IT Kamianets AI Framework

Also called AI ITKP.

> A framework for building AI agents from reusable npm packages: an agent engine for Node.js (ai-core), model providers (ai-ollama for local models), tool integrations (ai-unity, ai-assetra, ai-firebase), and constructors (starter repositories). openUnity, an agent for the Unity Editor, is the first agent built on it. Status: being designed; every package is planned and names and APIs may still change.

## Packages

- [packages.md](https://ai.itkamianets.com/packages.md): every package with its purpose, usage, dependencies, planned API and npm name, plus the constructors and agents. Read this to choose packages for a new agent.

## Docs

- [Build an agent](https://ai.itkamianets.com/docs/build-an-agent): clone the CLI Agent starter repository (ai-constructor-cli) under your agent's name, choose a provider and tools, write the agent's prompts, rules and skills, name agent packages `<agent>-<part>`, send framework changes back as pull requests.
- [Installation](https://ai.itkamianets.com/docs/installation): Node.js 24 LTS, Ollama, Unity 6000.6 for ai-unity, npm names under the @itkamianets scope.
- [Architecture](https://ai.itkamianets.com/docs/architecture): layers (schemas, core, providers, integrations, constructors, agent packages), what is inside ai-core, how a request runs, the MCP client (agents are MCP clients only), prompts, rules and skills as Markdown, the HTTP API for apps (contract: ai-api-schema).
- [Security](https://ai.itkamianets.com/docs/security): privileged work on the agent host, tool permissions, user approval, secrets never sent to the model, open questions.
- [Examples](https://ai.itkamianets.com/docs/examples): the first run of openUnity and a session.

## Related

- [IT Kamianets 3D Engine](https://3d.itkamianets.com): the sister project, Unity packages for 3D games.

## Source

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/IT-Kamianets): one repository per package, constructor and agent.
